comments.author: Armie
comments.body:
I guess this is more useful in cooperating with a melee partner, since it can exhaust enemy's water supply (i.e. surgery N/A).

Armouring deterioration bullet (ADB) does not work as well as I expected it to be. It does not always trigger on initiating fire with broadside. Each successful occurrence only reduces very small amount of armor.

I once equipped 5x master Vulkan 16 against gio's AFCV with 97 armor using ADB. after 5 minutes spamming flameshots with ADB, the average damage only increased by 50 (so moving from 50ish to 100ish), the effect was not very impressive.
